brief.title: Self-service returns portal
business_goals: Reduce customer support agent workload related to returns
Enable customers to initiate returns independently from their order history
Ensure refunds are only issued for items physically received and scanned by the warehouse
Improve financial reconciliation for return-related transactions
Provide real-time updates on return status and refund processing
Enhance customer communication regarding return progress via email
Accurately process partial refunds, including proportional shipping costs

stakeholders.name: Meera Nair
concerns: Agents spend about 40% of their day creating return labels and answering 'where is my refund'
Customers need to start a return themselves without contacting support
Returns outside 30 days from delivery must be rejected automatically
Customers should get an email at each step: return approved with label, item received, refund issued
Project needs to be live before the Diwali sale (end of October)

stakeholders.name: Rahul Desai
concerns: Refunds cannot be issued until the warehouse has scanned the item back in
Lost ₹18 lakh in refunds last quarter for items that never arrived
Need a daily report of refunds issued, pending, and rejected, broken down by reason code for reconciliation
Partial returns need to be handled accurately, including share of shipping

stakeholders.name: Priya Shah
concerns: When item arrives, scanning the barcode on the return label should update status immediately and trigger refund
Our scanners are Zebra handhelds that post to a REST endpoint

stakeholders.name: Ankit Verma
concerns: Order history lives in Shopify, must read orders from Shopify API
Refunds go through Razorpay, same as today
Portal needs to handle peak volume (Diwali week: 12,000 orders/day, 8% returns)
Page loads should stay under 2 seconds at peak volume

constraints: Return window is 30 days from delivery; anything outside must be rejected automatically
Refunds cannot be issued until the warehouse has scanned the item back in
Orders must be read from the Shopify API
Refunds must be processed through Razorpay
Warehouse scanners (Zebra handhelds) post to a REST endpoint for return status updates
Portal must handle peak volume of 12,000 orders/day with 8% returns
Page loads must stay under 2 seconds at peak volume
Project must be live before the Diwali sale (end of October)
out_of_scope: Exchanges are out of scope for this phase — refund only

requirements.statement: The system shall allow customers to initiate a return from their order history.
requirements.evidence: We need customers to be able to start a return themselves from their order history without contacting us.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically reject return requests submitted more than 30 days after delivery.
requirements.evidence: Anything outside that must be rejected automatically with a clear message, not sent to an agent.

requirements.statement: The system shall display a clear message to the customer when a return request is rejected due to being outside the return window.
requirements.evidence: Anything outside that must be rejected automatically with a clear message, not sent to an agent.

requirements.statement: The system shall prevent the issuance of a refund until the warehouse has confirmed receipt of the returned item.
requirements.evidence: The system has to hold the refund until the warehouse confirms receipt.

requirements.statement: The system shall generate a daily report detailing refunds issued, pending, and rejected, categorized by reason code.
requirements.evidence: We also need a daily report of refunds issued, pending, and rejected, broken down by reason code

requirements.statement: The system shall update the return status immediately upon receiving a scan event from the warehouse.
requirements.evidence: The scan should update the return status immediately

requirements.statement: The system shall trigger the refund process upon successful receipt confirmation from the warehouse.
The system shall integrate with the warehouse scanning system via a REST endpoint to receive return item receipt confirmations.
requirements.evidence: Our scanners are Zebra handhelds that post to a REST endpoint

requirements.statement: The system shall send an email notification to the customer when a return is approved, including the return label.
requirements.evidence: Customers should get an email at each step: return approved with the label attached

requirements.statement: The system shall send an email notification to the customer when the returned item is received by the warehouse.
requirements.evidence: Customers should get an email at each step: item received

requirements.statement: The system shall send an email notification to the customer when a refund has been issued.
requirements.evidence: Customers should get an email at each step: refund issued.

requirements.statement: The system shall retrieve customer order history from the Shopify API.
requirements.evidence: Whatever we build has to read orders from the Shopify API

requirements.statement: The system shall process refunds through the Razorpay payment gateway.
requirements.evidence: Refunds go through Razorpay, same as today.

requirements.statement: The system shall load pages within 2 seconds during peak volume, defined as 12,000 orders per day with 8% returns.
requirements.evidence: Page loads should stay under 2 seconds at that volume.

requirements.statement: The system shall calculate partial refunds for individual returned items, including their proportional share of shipping costs if applicable.
requirements.evidence: the refund should be for that item only, including its share of shipping if we charged it.

epics.title: Customer Return Management
epics.goal: Empower customers to independently initiate, track, and receive updates on their return requests.

epics.title: Refund Processing Automation
epics.goal: Guarantee that refunds are processed correctly and only after returned items are confirmed received by the warehouse.

epics.title: Return Financial Reporting
epics.goal: Offer comprehensive reporting to support financial reconciliation and tracking of return-related transactions.

epics.title: Returns Portal Performance
epics.goal: Ensure the returns portal delivers a fast and responsive experience for customers.

stories.title: Initiate Return from Order History
stories.i_want: to select items from my order history for return
stories.so_that: I can easily start a return request without contacting support

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and have an order with returnable items
acceptance_criteria.when: I view my order history and select an order
acceptance_criteria.then: I see an option to initiate a return for eligible items

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and have an order with no returnable items
acceptance_criteria.when: I view my order history and select an order
acceptance_criteria.then: I do not see an option to initiate a return

stories.title: Enforce Return Window Policy
stories.i_want: to know if my return request is within the allowed timeframe
stories.so_that: I don't waste time submitting an ineligible return and understand the reason for rejection

acceptance_criteria.given: I am initiating a return for an item delivered 29 days ago
acceptance_criteria.when: I submit my return request
acceptance_criteria.then: My return request is successfully submitted

acceptance_criteria.given: I am initiating a return for an item delivered 31 days ago
acceptance_criteria.when: I submit my return request
acceptance_criteria.then: My return request is rejected and I see a message 'Return requests must be submitted within 30 days of delivery.'

stories.title: Integrate Shopify Order History
stories.so_that: I can easily select an item to return

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer logs into the returns portal
acceptance_criteria.when: The portal requests their order history
acceptance_criteria.then: The portal successfully retrieves and displays order data from the Shopify API

acceptance_criteria.given: The Shopify API is unavailable
acceptance_criteria.when: The portal attempts to retrieve order history
acceptance_criteria.then: The portal displays an error message 'Unable to load order history. Please try again later.'

stories.title: Send Return Approval Email with Label
stories.i_want: to receive an email with my return label
stories.so_that: I can easily print it and send back my items

acceptance_criteria.given: My return request has been approved
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the approval
acceptance_criteria.then: An email is sent to my registered email address with a printable return label attached

acceptance_criteria.given: My return request has been approved but email sending fails
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to send the approval email
acceptance_criteria.then: The system logs the failure and marks the email for retry

stories.title: Send Item Received Email Notification
stories.i_want: to be notified when my returned items arrive at the warehouse
stories.so_that: I know my return is progressing and I can expect my refund soon

acceptance_criteria.given: The warehouse confirms receipt of my returned item
acceptance_criteria.when: The system receives the receipt confirmation
acceptance_criteria.then: An email is sent to my registered email address confirming item receipt

acceptance_criteria.given: The warehouse confirms receipt of my returned item, but the email address is invalid
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to send the receipt confirmation email
acceptance_criteria.then: The system logs the email sending failure

stories.title: Send Refund Issued Email Notification
stories.i_want: to be notified when my refund has been processed
stories.so_that: I can track the refund to my payment method

acceptance_criteria.given: My refund has been successfully issued
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the refund
acceptance_criteria.then: An email is sent to my registered email address confirming the refund amount and transaction details

acceptance_criteria.given: My refund has been successfully issued, but the email server is down
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to send the refund confirmation email
acceptance_criteria.then: The system queues the email for later delivery and logs the initial failure

stories.title: Integrate Warehouse Scan Events
stories.i_want: the system to receive real-time updates from the warehouse scanning system
stories.so_that: I can ensure accurate tracking of returned items and initiate subsequent processes

acceptance_criteria.given: The warehouse scanning system sends a receipt confirmation for a returned item
acceptance_criteria.when: The returns portal receives the REST API call
acceptance_criteria.then: The returns portal successfully processes and records the item receipt

acceptance_criteria.given: The warehouse scanning system sends an invalid receipt confirmation
acceptance_criteria.when: The returns portal receives the REST API call
acceptance_criteria.then: The returns portal rejects the request and logs the error

stories.title: Update Return Status Real-time
stories.i_want: my return status to update instantly when the warehouse receives my item
stories.so_that: I always know the current progress of my return

acceptance_criteria.given: A return has a status of 'In Transit'
acceptance_criteria.when: The system receives a warehouse scan event confirming receipt
acceptance_criteria.then: The return status is updated to 'Received at Warehouse' within 1 second

acceptance_criteria.given: A return has a status of 'In Transit'
acceptance_criteria.when: The system receives a warehouse scan event for an unknown return ID
acceptance_criteria.then: The system logs an error and does not update any return status

stories.title: Automate Refund Trigger on Receipt
stories.i_want: the system to automatically initiate the refund process only for received items
stories.so_that: I can be confident that refunds are processed securely and without manual intervention after item receipt

acceptance_criteria.given: A returned item's receipt is successfully confirmed by the warehouse
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the receipt confirmation
acceptance_criteria.then: A refund request is queued for the payment gateway

acceptance_criteria.given: A return request is approved but the item has not been confirmed received by the warehouse
acceptance_criteria.when: A refund attempt is triggered for that item
acceptance_criteria.then: The refund is blocked and an alert is generated for manual review

stories.notes: Removed AC3 as it introduced new scope not covered by existing requirements and lacked specific criteria for eligibility.

stories.title: Integrate Razorpay for Refunds
stories.i_want: the system to process refunds through Razorpay
stories.so_that: I can efficiently issue refunds to customers via their original payment method

acceptance_criteria.given: A refund request is initiated for a customer
acceptance_criteria.when: The system sends a refund request to the Razorpay API
acceptance_criteria.then: Razorpay successfully processes the refund and returns a confirmation

acceptance_criteria.given: A refund request is initiated, but Razorpay returns an error (e.g., insufficient funds, invalid transaction)
acceptance_criteria.when: The system sends a refund request to the Razorpay API
acceptance_criteria.then: The system logs the error and flags the refund for manual intervention

stories.title: Calculate Partial Refunds
stories.i_want: the system to accurately calculate partial refunds for returned items
stories.so_that: customers receive the correct refund amount, including proportional shipping costs, and our financial records are accurate

acceptance_criteria.given: An order with multiple items and a total shipping cost
acceptance_criteria.when: A subset of items is returned
acceptance_criteria.then: The refund amount for the returned items is calculated based on their individual price and their proportional share of the original shipping cost

acceptance_criteria.given: An order with a single item and a shipping cost
acceptance_criteria.when: The item is returned
acceptance_criteria.then: The refund amount is calculated to include the item's full price and the full shipping cost

stories.notes: Rephrased AC2.then to include an observable outcome verb.

stories.title: Generate Daily Refund Status Report
stories.i_want: a daily report on refund statuses
stories.so_that: I can reconcile financial records and track return-related transactions

acceptance_criteria.given: It is the end of the business day
acceptance_criteria.when: The system generates the daily refund report
acceptance_criteria.then: The report is generated and contains all refunds issued, pending, and rejected for that day, categorized by reason code

acceptance_criteria.given: There are no refund activities for the day
acceptance_criteria.when: The system generates the daily refund report
acceptance_criteria.then: The report is generated with empty sections for each category

stories.title: Fast Loading of Order History Page
stories.i_want: the order history page in the returns portal to load within 2 seconds
stories.so_that: I can quickly find and select items for return without frustration

acceptance_criteria.given: The system is operating under peak load (12,000 orders/day, 8% returns)
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to my order history page in the returns portal
acceptance_criteria.then: The order history page loads completely within 2 seconds

acceptance_criteria.given: The system is operating under peak load
acceptance_criteria.when: Multiple customers simultaneously access their order history page
acceptance_criteria.then: The order history page loads for each customer within 2 seconds

stories.notes: Revised to focus on a specific page (Order History) to make the story smaller, more estimable, and less vague, addressing NFR concerns by applying it to a concrete user flow. Story points adjusted to reflect more focused scope.

gaps.description: The requirements do not include any security non-functional requirements for the customer-facing portal, which will handle customer order data and initiate financial transactions. This is a critical omission for an e-commerce platform.
gaps.suggested_question: What are our security requirements for the customer returns portal, especially regarding customer data protection, authentication, and preventing unauthorized refund initiation?

gaps.description: There are no explicit availability or uptime targets for the self-service returns portal, which is critical for customer satisfaction and reducing support load, especially during peak sales periods like Diwali.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the expected uptime and availability targets for the returns portal, particularly during high-traffic periods like the Diwali sale?

gaps.description: The project involves handling customer personal data (order history) and financial transactions (refunds). There is no mention of a Legal or Compliance stakeholder, whose input would be crucial for data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, local laws) and financial compliance.
gaps.suggested_question: Who is responsible for ensuring the returns portal complies with data privacy regulations and financial compliance requirements, and have they reviewed these requirements?

gaps.description: Requirement R-006 states the return status should update 'immediately' upon receiving a scan event. 'Immediately' is subjective and lacks a measurable definition for acceptable latency, which is important for providing real-time updates.
related_ids: Goal: Provide real-time updates on return status and refund processing
gaps.suggested_question: What is the maximum acceptable delay for a return status update after a warehouse scan event to be considered 'immediate' or 'real-time'?

gaps.description: Requirement R-003 states the system shall display a 'clear message' when a return request is rejected. The definition of 'clear' is subjective and could lead to different interpretations regarding the content and presentation of the message.
gaps.suggested_question: What specific information should be included in the rejection message for out-of-window returns to ensure it's 'clear' to customers?

gaps.coverage_note: The backlog provides good coverage for the stated business goals, particularly in enabling customer self-service for returns, automating refund triggers, and improving financial reconciliation. Key functional and integration requirements are addressed, and a critical performance non-functional requirement is included. However, there are some areas that need further clarification to ensure a robust and compliant solution, especially regarding security, availability, and legal compliance, which are not explicitly covered.
